$comment: The iteration engine's memory. references/eval-rubric.md defines six human dimensions and a protocol where a divergence of two forces a retrospective, and until 0.1.390 not one score was stored: every number in the record was a sentence inside a release note, so no dimension could be read over time and the loop had no way to show whether it was working. THE SCHEMA HAS NO FREE-TEXT FIELD, deliberately. A scores file is exactly the shape that breaks red line 9 — a 'notes' column is where a client name arrives — so the guard is not optional and there is nowhere for prose to go. Reasons belong in CHANGELOG.md, which is already written under that red line. A null score means not scored in that round, never zero.
